# Apply Progress — Role Port, Slice A (issue #312)

Mode: Strict TDD. Store: hybrid (also written to openspec/changes/issue-312-role-port/apply-progress.md in worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-312, branch feat/issue-312-featsdd-role-as-port-per-action-executor). First and only batch. Phases 1-3 (30/36 tasks) implemented and green, UNCOMMITTED by explicit instruction (no commit/push/PR this run). Phase 4 (follow-up issue, memory:share, push, PR) blocked pending human action.

## Baseline discrepancy
Stated baseline was 4520 pass/0 fail. Measured baseline on this worktree BEFORE any change: 4515 pass/5 fail — 5 pre-existing, unrelated failures in brain/scripts/memory/backends/plainfiles.save-index-failure.test.mjs (issue #637). Confirmed unrelated (exist pre-change; this slice never touches brain/scripts/memory/**). Fail count never grew across the whole apply run.

## TDD Cycle Evidence (RED→GREEN, all confirmed by running node --test before/after)
- 1.2-1.5 stage-config.mjs (zero-config identity, 3 refusals, disable, agent passthrough): RED on missing module, GREEN 8/8.
- 2.2-2.7 role-port.mjs (seam-absent module+per-stage, concrete model_tier refused, chooses_model strict, dispatch order, proposal answered/D7 trap): RED on missing module, GREEN 17/17 (after 2 test-wording fixes, not production fixes).
- 2.9-2.10 SDD_ENGINES extraction: RED on missing export, GREEN 20/20 in cli.test.mjs.
- 3.3 plain.declareRoles: RED on missing export, GREEN 8/8 in plain.test.mjs.
- 3.5-3.8 roles.contract.test.mjs (parity loop n=1, dated debt comment "PARITY DEBT — #312, dated 2026-08-31", membership-based abstraction check, tripwire): no separate RED phase — this file IS the GREEN wiring task (3.8), written directly against already-implemented units, passed 11/11 on first run. Recorded rather than fabricating a RED cycle.

## Files changed
Created: brain/scripts/lib/stage-config.mjs (102 lines) + .test.mjs (106); brain/scripts/roles/role-port.mjs (174) + .test.mjs (223); brain/scripts/roles/roles.contract.test.mjs (140); brain/scripts/roles/fixtures/stage-set-custom.json (16); openspec/changes/issue-312-role-port/brain-drafts/config-migrations-1.3.0.md (draft, not applied).
Modified: brain/scripts/harness/backends/plain.mjs (+24, declareRoles, additive, AGENT_RUNTIME/init untouched) + plain.test.mjs (+32, byte-identical AGENT_RUNTIME assertion preserved); brain/scripts/harness/platform.mjs (+12, export const SDD_ENGINES); brain/scripts/harness/cli.mjs (+7/-3, resolveEngine reads SDD_ENGINES) + cli.test.mjs (+35); openspec/changes/issue-312-role-port/tasks.md (checkboxes updated, 30/36 done).
Untouched: brain/scripts/harness/backends/gentle-ai.mjs (Option A); brain/core/config-migrations.mjs and other brain/core/**/brain/project/** (Tier 3, never touched); brain/scripts/lib/stage-engine.mjs + stage-engine.test.mjs (git diff empty — byte-identical, confirmed).

## Countable lines (governance.ignoreList excludes **/*.test.mjs, openspec/changes/**)
Unit 1: 102. Unit 2: role-port.mjs 174 + platform.mjs 12 + cli.mjs 10 = 196. Unit 3: plain.mjs 24 + fixture 16 = 40. TOTAL COUNTABLE = 338 lines against tier lite's 1000-line budget — well clear, no workload decision re-triggered. (tasks.md forecast was ~405; actual came in lower.)

## Deviations from design (flagged explicitly, not silently bent)
1. role-port.mjs does NOT import stage-engine.mjs's resolveStageEngine for sdd.map reads, despite the data-flow diagram implying it. D1's prose is explicit and load-bearing: "roles/ and stage-engine.mjs are both consumers of sdd-layout.mjs. Neither imports the other." Honored the prose (a stated invariant) over the diagram (implicit). Implemented a private, permissive inline reader `readRoutedModel(config, stage)` inside role-port.mjs instead — reads config?.sdd?.map?.[stage]?.model directly, no validation duplication (that's #323's, covered by stage-engine.test.mjs already).
2. That inline routed-model lookup is skipped ENTIRELY when role.model_tier === null, so resolveModelSelection's no-agent note ("no id was read from sdd.map") stays literally true rather than describing a value that was fetched-then-discarded — exactly the failure mode design D4's text warns against.
3. No separate RED phase for roles.contract.test.mjs (see TDD Evidence note above) — structural, not a shortcut: tasks 3.5-3.7 are labeled RED but have no corresponding GREEN implementation step of their own; 3.8 IS the GREEN step and it is that test file.
4. Two test-wording fixes in role-port.test.mjs after first GREEN run (case-sensitive regex; over-strict "must never contain the word disabled" assertion that didn't allow the negated wording agent-runtime.mjs's seam-missing notice already uses). Both confirmed as test-quality fixes by reading actual correct production output first.
No other deviations — D2, D3, D5, D6, D7 all match design as written.

## Verification
npm test: 4557 pass / 5 fail (same 5 pre-existing #637 failures, unchanged) / 4562 total. npm run repo:check: green. npm run brain:nav: green. No writes to brain/core/** or brain/project/** (verified via git status grep). AGENTS.md untouched.

## Migration draft status
openspec/changes/issue-312-role-port/brain-drafts/config-migrations-1.3.0.md is a DRAFT, NOT APPLIED (Tier 3 restriction — brain/core/config-migrations.mjs off-limits). Carries D6's exact ordering-constraint sentence: 1.3.0 valid only if #456's 1.2.0 promotes first; confirmed #456's 1.2.0 draft (openspec/changes/issue-456-stage-set/brain-drafts/config-migrations-1.2.0.md) is ALSO still unpromoted at time of this apply run (verified: config-migrations.mjs's last real entry is still '0.10.0', brain-config.test.mjs still asserts schemaVersion '0.10.0') — both drafts target the identical brain-config.test.mjs schemaVersion line, confirmed by direct inspection.

## Remaining / blocked
1.8, 2.12, 3.11 (commit each unit) and all of Phase 4 (follow-up issue, memory:share+push, PR, label+CI, brain:review) are BLOCKED by explicit orchestrator instruction: do NOT commit, push, or open a PR this run. Working tree left with all Phase 1-3 changes uncommitted for human review. next_recommended: sdd-apply again (human-authorized) to commit + run Phase 4, or sdd-verify against the uncommitted tree first.
